gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-kedebideri: Conthrax keeps its bowls and stems matched in weight, giving the display letters a clean geometric look. But Kedebideri does the quiet work, with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open and inviting.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-khula: Sleek and tubular, Conthrax runs its strokes with parallel edges through every curve. Khula sits beneath with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open, which keeps the stack tidy and modern.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-krub: Poured-ink letters, wide and tall-bodied: that is Conthrax, uniform in width from start to finish. Krub loosens things up beside it, its pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves feeling hand-touched against all that machined sameness.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-kufam: Conthrax gives its lowercase a a wide mouth and makes capitals barely taller than the bodies. And Kufam, drawn like neon tube with open curves in the e, would run through paragraphs steadily, bodies dominating the line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-deca: Conthrax is all geometry, tall-bodied and cleanly drawn. It makes a strong display statement, while Lexend Deca does the steady talking, with an unshaded line that never swells and terminals that stop short of curling back.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-liter: Liter reads with no stroke contrast at all, its lowercase standing tall and its round forms wide-mouthed. Then Conthrax steps in up top, geometric and clean, so the two feel like one engineered system.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mada: Mada is a sans-serif with curves that refuse to close. Conthrax is the showpiece, its thin joins no thinner than its stems, while Mada handles the text with that towering midzone.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans gives every curve generous room. Beneath Conthrax, whose strokes look pulled like solder through a nozzle, that high mean line keeps long paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-matangi: Conthrax sets a wide-mouthed lowercase a and tall bodies in a geometric, clean display voice. But Matangi, a plain sans with twine-like strokes and a hefty lowercase, grounds the heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro has a welcoming gap in the c. Next to Conthrax, wide and geometric, its gentle monotone line and high-waisted lowercase feel friendlier, like a softer voice beside a machined one.
